dispatch_architecture.ptr_table: {name_ptr, func_ptr, 0} stride-12; dispatcher resolves name->C function. Used by AVTransport, RenderingControl, DeviceProperties, GroupRenderingControl, ContentDirectory, Queue, GroupManagement, VirtualLineIn.
dispatch_architecture.id_table: {name_ptr, vfunc_offset, 0} stride-12, SORTED by name; dispatcher binary-searches name, then calls *(service_obj.vtable + id) via bctrl (m9 dispatcher @0x10823970; id&1 selects the virtual path, all observed ids odd). Actions are C++ virtual methods on the service object — a DIFFERENT mechanism than ptr-table. Used by SystemProperties, ZoneGroupTopology, AlarmClock, ConnectionManager, MusicServices (and HTControl on model-9).
dispatch_architecture.id_table_shared_service_object: the SystemProperties+ZGT id-table at 0x10f0d20c mixes BOTH services' actions (BeginSoftwareUpdate..SubmitDiagnostics + GetZoneGroupAttributes/GetZoneGroupState) — these services are facades onto ONE player-level C++ object; different SCPD/XML faces, same vtable.
dispatch_architecture.strcmp_dispatch: AudioIn (6) + QPlayAuth handled by name-comparison fallback, not a table
dispatch_architecture.availability_states: compiled=code/string in binary; registered=route+service object exists; advertised=in SCPD; callable=dispatch path reaches impl; stubbed=dispatched to reject-all/stub; removed=no compiled string/table

capability_gate.mechanism: fenway reads hwmodel/submodel at boot via HAL/config call (fn 0x10571730 logs 'hwmodel'), then matches it against a 'model_list'/'update_list' config list (supported_models at fn 0x1056b658 reads obj+2388 index)
capability_gate.dispatch: 3-way switch on submodel index (values 1/2/3 = Play1/Play3/Sub) at 0x1056b6a8/0x1056b6b4/0x1056b6c0; each case does product-specific getProperty(0x1056b978 /282687956) lookups
capability_gate.fallback: fn 0x10b84ce8 returns error + logs 'Unsupported Fenway Submodel' for unrecognized model
capability_gate.conclusion: product capability is a RUNTIME data-driven gate (model_list config + hwmodel read), not compile-time — confirms one binary serves all fenway submodels, behavior selected by detected hardware
